test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word.**

Incompetent
solution: The correct answer is: **Dexterous**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Incompetent **means lacking the necessary skills or ability to do something. (कुछ करने के लिए आवश्यक कौशल या क्षमता का अभाव) • **Example**: The employee's incompetent performance led to multiple errors and delays in the project. • Marked option **Dexterous **means having or showing skill, especially with the hands. (कौशल रखना या दिखाना, विशेषकर हाथों से) • **Example**: The dexterous musician effortlessly played a complex piece on the piano, impressing the audience with precision and skill. • Therefore, the opposite of incompetent is dexterous. • Grammatically, the two words are antonyms. Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Forlorn **means sad and lonely. (दुखी और अकेला) • **Desperate **means feeling or showing a sense of hopelessness. (निराशा की भावना महसूस करना या दिखाना) • **Hopeless **means feeling or causing despair about something. (किसी बात को लेकर निराशा महसूस करना या पैदा करना) 14c:Tad3, The correct answer is: **Recluse**.
